run_launch_action: run launch_action to submit a SLURM job from command-line arguments and a DecoratedMain instance
cancel_remote_job: cancel a running remote SLURM job by calling launch_action with the cancel flag set
clear_and_resubmit_job: clear an existing job and its XP folder then resubmit via launch_action with the clear flag
tail_job_logs: tail the last 200 lines of a remote job log in real time using launch_action with tail enabled
attach_and_kill_on_interrupt: attach to a remote job and automatically kill it on keyboard interrupt using launch_action with attach
